items.headline: Price move coincides with 1 major outage(s) same day
items.detail: Wide intraday MCP spread: 152% of daily average on 2026-05-16, same day as: ADANI POWER unit 2: 600.0 MW affected (~600 MW total affected capacity). Reduced supply is a plausible contributing driver, alongside demand-side factors -- not asserted as the sole cause.
